summary: Constellation Energy Corporation and Constellation Energy Generation, LLC filed an 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events reporting results of the PJM capacity auction for the 2028–2029 planning year. All of the company's PJM power plants cleared the auction, with nuclear units totaling 15,700 MW and fossil/other units 3,175 MW, at a price of $325 per MW-day across multiple zones. Capacity revenues for nuclear units will be included in Production Tax Credit gross receipts calculation. The auction results take effect June 1, 2028. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms exist.
